title: Black Friday: Your $80 Buys 1 GTA 6 or 3 Games
caption:
Black Friday on Steam: Red Dead 2 $14.99, Oblivion Remastered $29.99 and 007 First Light $34.99 add up to $79.97. GTA 6 Standard is $79.99 on its own. Same money, three games.
Which would you buy: GTA 6 or all three?

Sources: Steam store (US prices, 27 Nov), Rockstar Games
ig_first_line: $79.97. That's Red Dead 2, Oblivion Remastered and 007 First Light on Steam today. Or one GTA 6.
